title: feat: minify colors in var() fallback values
author: yisibl
summary: Parses named-color idents (and color functions) inside unparsed token lists, e.g. var() fallbacks and gradients that contain var(), into Color tokens, so `var(--c, white)` -> `var(--c,#fff)`. It's gated by a per-property whitelist and by whether the enclosing function is a color or image function. About 600 lines of TokenList plumbing for a size-only gain, and it changes tokens that JS visitors see (Ident -> Color).
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI (target/review/base-574eee2/lightningcss; master-build.log was still empty): `#bar{color:var(--c, white)}` -> `#bar{color:var(--c,white)}` (as #601 describes). The diff changes existing test expectations and also edits test inputs: `.old-radial { radial-gradient(0 50%, ...) }` was renamed to `.old-webkit-radial` with a `-webkit-` input, and `.direction` likewise. A visitor test changes `blue` -> `#00f`. Leftover non-English comment (`// 允许解析颜色的函数`). The author (a repo member) pinged twice (2026-02-08, 2026-03-16) with no maintainer reply.
decision: Is minifying color keywords inside unparsed/var() token lists worth ~600 lines of property-whitelisted token-list logic and a visible change to the tokens JS visitors receive?
